title: RAG Proxy Pointer Contract
description: Schema for exact-document proxy-pointer retrieval inside the memory spine.

pointerId.description: Unique identifier for the proxy pointer (e.g., ptr_a1b2c3d4)

summary.description: The distilled, dense semantic summary used for vector embedding generation. This is what the vector DB searches against.

canonicalUri.description: The absolute UNC path or URI to the raw, canonical file on the NAS (e.g., \\127.0.0.1\docker\genesis-deploy\rag_data\academy\udemy\aim810-genai.json)

domain.description: The knowledge domain this pointer belongs to (e.g., academy, tech, strategy, operations)

tags.description: Optional keyword tags for hybrid search filtering
